title: Run the focused TypeSafe example test offline with -k typesafe
answers: how do I run the TypeSafe example test
run typesafe judge example tests without an API key
body:
Command: `UV_FROZEN=1 uv run pytest -q tests/examples/test_examples.py -k typesafe`.
The test sets TYPESAFE_API_KEY with monkeypatch, so no real key is needed.
It patches mlflow.genai.judges.typesafe._get_http_response_with_retries and runs examples/typesafe_judges/evaluate.py via runpy, so no network call is made.
It expects 4 HTTP calls (2 rows x 2 judges) and checks that each trace carries typesafe.probability and typesafe.probabilities assessment metadata.
The test must use the db_uri fixture; a fresh tmp_path SQLite DB makes it slow.
applies: Local and CI verification of the TypeSafe judge example and docs.
says: Verify the AI judge documentation example locally without requiring an external service key
Running the automated assessment sample fails when offline or without account credentials configured
Ensure evaluation traces record expected judge confidence and probability scores during sample execution
Speed up evaluation example verification by avoiding fresh database creation for each run
search: Running tests/examples/test_examples.py:test_typesafe_judges_example offline uses UV_FROZEN=1 uv run pytest -q tests/examples/test_examples.py -k typesafe without requiring network access or an API key. The test monkeypatches TYPESAFE_API_KEY, patches mlflow.genai.judges.typesafe._get_http_response_with_retries, and executes examples/typesafe_judges/evaluate.py through runpy. It verifies four HTTP responses across two rows and two judges, asserting that traces record typesafe.probability and typesafe.probabilities assessment metadata. The test must use the db_uri fixture because a fresh tmp_path SQLite database causes slow execution.
